Wikipedia-only entries of 27 Nov: France in recession after two quarters of contraction; Bangladesh BNP-Awami League clash; Indonesian mine search ended.
ČTK-only or sport: Český slavík (covered, cz-slavik), Davis Cup, Sparta coach, ice and frost warning, school canteen rules.
